Raley's closed a store location in Roseville, Calif., in January 2026 as part of ongoing store closures.

data.status: long-awaited opening; officially opens to the public
data.short_description: AndyS, a restaurant, sports bar and entertainment venue, celebrated its long-awaited opening with a ribbon cutting and open house in downtown Ludington. The roughly $10 million venue officially opens to the public Sunday, Aug. 16.

See Use Again, a small business that keeps art supplies out of landfills by redistributing them, held its grand opening in Urbana. Founder Meg McDonald started the business out of her garage before securing a storefront.

Esh Circus Arts is expanding to a second location in East Somerville because its main studio is at capacity. The satellite space is being prepared for adult sessions starting Aug. 24 and kids' sessions starting Sept. 14.

Spice in Heights, a new Mediterranean restaurant in Houston's Heights neighborhood, opened this summer with a menu of mezze, grilled meats and tagines. It's currently open for dinner only, with a lunch menu planned for the future.

Aloha Manapua opened its third and newest location in Waimalu Shopping Center, featuring dine-in seating and a takeout window. A grand opening celebration with a lion dance is planned for the following day.
Mac's Old House, an iconic Antioch restaurant, held its Grand Opening on Saturday, Aug. 15.

Gem Studio, a jewelry-making workshop brand with humanitarian roots, plans to open its first Texas location at Stonebriar Centre in Frisco. The concept donates a portion of revenue to a nonprofit supporting at-risk children in Uganda.

Doro Marketplace, a European-style bakery and café, is looking at opening a new location in an upcoming Milford shopping plaza. An opening could occur in early 2027, according to an engineer representing the property owners.

data.store_name: Rock Valley College Downtown West Campus
data.short_description: Rock Valley College celebrated the opening of its new Downtown West Campus, a nearly $53 million project over a decade in the making. The campus includes a Downtown Learning Center and Downtown Training Center for education and career programs.

Jollibee Foods Corp. closed 207 stores in the first half of 2026 and lowered its target for new openings due to weaker financial results and higher costs. It still plans to open 1,000 to 1,100 new stores by the end of 2026.

Limegreen Southeast Asian Grill, a family-owned restaurant with a Chipotle-style take on Southeast Asian food, had a soft opening Aug. 13 in Leander's Southbrook Station. It officially opens Aug. 21, with discounted prices through Aug. 23.

Clovis Unified's Terry Bradley Education Center is opening new facilities, including a completed Industrial Arts Building and newly finished swimming pools. A new competition gymnasium is nearing completion, with performing arts buildings expected by the end of 2026.
